reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 38 B1/B2 verb questions: checked every full German sentence, all four options, inflection, verb valency, unique accepted answer, bilingual feedback and two distinct contexts. Mapped kaputt machen to kaputtmachen duplicate; contrasted transitive kaputtmachen with intransitive kaputtgehen. Corrected klagen legal sense, klicken digital sense, klingen broader sound sense, and reflexive sich konzentrieren. Inherited examples not copied. Human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review pending. Follow-up AI correction: revised klicken variant 2 to natural user-as-agent phrasing.
